## Introduction
I want to find DMPs for the contrast between all mild and moderate COPD types vs only Ex Smokers. The idea is to compare the DMPs obtained from this contrast and compare with the DMPs from SEO vs control EX-smokers.

```{r}
BMIQ.betas<- BMIQ.betas.norm.ftr
m.values = ENmix::B2M(BMIQ.betas)
dim(m.values)

# Remove sample from pheno.data that was removed by ENmix
sample_keep =  which(rownames(pheno.data) %in% base::colnames(m.values))
pheno.data = pheno.data[sample_keep,]

idx.subjects <- match(rownames(pheno.data), base::colnames(m.values))
m.values <- m.values[,idx.subjects]
dim(m.values)
```

# Aplly filter

```{r}
mtx.win.betas <- as.matrix(BMIQ.betas)

# Match samples in the beta matrix with metadata
ctrl.samples <- pheno.data[pheno.data$com_COPD_Y_or_N == "Control_ES",]  # Samples in the control group
cCOPD.samples <- pheno.data[pheno.data$com_COPD_Y_or_N == "common_COPD",] # Samples in the disease group

ctrl.betas <- mtx.win.betas[, colnames(mtx.win.betas) %in% rownames(ctrl.samples)]
copd.betas <- mtx.win.betas[, colnames(mtx.win.betas) %in% rownames(cCOPD.samples)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 4: Calculate mean methylation levels for each CpG
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Calculate mean beta values for each CpG (row)
ctrl.means <- rowMeans(ctrl.betas, na.rm = TRUE)
copd.means <- rowMeans(copd.betas, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create a dataframe with one CpG per row
cpgs.df <- data.frame(
  CpG = rownames(mtx.win.betas),
  ctrl_mean = ctrl.means,
  cCOPD_mean = copd.means,
  delta_mean = copd.means - ctrl.means
)

# Add absolute delta mean
cpgs.df$abs_delta_mean <- abs(cpgs.df$delta_mean)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5: Apply final filters
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Define filtering criteria
MIN_DELTA <- 0.05      # 5% minimum methylation difference
MIN_BETA <- 0.2         # Lower bound for mean beta value
MAX_BETA <- 0.8         # Upper bound for mean beta value

# Apply filters:
# 1. Absolute methylation difference > 5%
# 2. Mean beta values between 20-80% in both groups
filtered.cpgs <- cpgs.df[
  cpgs.df$abs_delta_mean > MIN_DELTA &
  cpgs.df$cCOPD_mean > MIN_BETA & cpgs.df$cCOPD_mean < MAX_BETA &
  cpgs.df$ctrl_mean > MIN_BETA & cpgs.df$ctrl_mean < MAX_BETA,
]

# View the filtered results
#head(filtered.cpgs)

idx.cpgs <- match(rownames(filtered.cpgs), base::rownames(m.values))
mtx.m.values <- m.values[idx.cpgs,]
dim(mtx.m.values)
```
# Winsorization per sample

```{r}
# Function to apply winsorization on EPIC array data
winsorize.epic.array <- function(data) {
  # Ensure the data is in a data frame format
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  
  # Apply winsorization per sample (column-wise)
  winsorized.data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ {
      # Calculate Q1, Q3, and IQR for the column (CpG-specific)
      Q1 <- quantile(., 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
      Q3 <- quantile(., 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      IQR <- Q3 - Q1
      
      # Define thresholds for extreme values (EVs)
      lower.threshold <- Q1 - (1.5 * IQR) # I use 1.5 times from IQR, more stringent.
      upper.threshold <- Q3 + (1.5 * IQR)
      
      # Winsorize values: replace EVs with thresholds
      . <- ifelse(. < lower.threshold, lower.threshold, .)
      . <- ifelse(. > upper.threshold, upper.threshold, .)
      
      return(.)
    }))
  
  return(winsorized.data)
}
```

```{r}
# Apply winsorization
win.samples.m.values <- winsorize.epic.array(mtx.m.values)
boxplot.color.group(pheno.data = pheno.data, m.value = win.samples.m.values)
```

### Run the regression model
- Check adding cell proportion, check if improve lambda.
- Use bacon package.

```{r warning=FALSE, message=True}
design <- model.matrix(
  ~0 + com_COPD_Y_or_N + Gender + Age + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + PC6 +PC7,
  data = pheno.data
)

original.fit <- limma::lmFit(
  win.samples.m.values,
  design,
  na.exclude=TRUE,
  method = "robust",# to handle outliers
  maxit = 200
)

# create a contrast matrix for specific comparisons
cont.matrix <- limma::makeContrasts(
  test = com_COPD_Y_or_Ncommon_COPD - com_COPD_Y_or_NControl_ES,
  levels = design
)

# Fit the contrasts
adjusted.fit <- limma::contrasts.fit(original.fit, cont.matrix)

# Calculate the moderate t-statistics that uses pooling
adjusted.fit <- limma::eBayes(adjusted.fit, 0.05) 
summary(limma::decideTests(adjusted.fit))
```

# Check residuals

```{r}
residuals <- residuals(original.fit, win.samples.m.values )  # Extract residuals

hist(residuals, breaks = 50, main = "Histogram of Residuals", xlab = "Residuals")
plot(density(residuals), main = "Density Plot of Residuals", xlab = "Residuals")

qqnorm(residuals, main = "Q-Q Plot of Residuals")
qqline(residuals, col = "red")  # Add a reference line

```

# Evaluate results

```{r}
# Get table of resulst from contrast 
DMPs <- limma::topTable(
  adjusted.fit,
  adjust = "BH",
  coef = "test",
  sort.by = "B",
  number = Inf
)

rownames(DMPs) <- rownames(win.samples.m.values)# Check this step, sanity check in case of shuffling cpg ids

nr_dm <- apply(DMPs, 2, function(x) {sum(abs(x))})[10]
summary(DMPs)
```

```{r}
hist(DMPs$`P.Value`, breaks=50)
```

### Annotate results

```{r}
results <- DMPs %>%

      as.data.frame() %>%
```

## Estimate Inflation
Genomic inflation factor
zscore = (x-μ)/σ

```{r}
effect.size = adjusted.fit$coefficients
stdError = sqrt(adjusted.fit$s2.post) * adjusted.fit$stdev.unscaled

zvalue <- effect.size / stdError
chisq  <- (zvalue) ^ 2

lambda_infl <- median(
  chisq,
  ) / qchisq(p = 0.5, df =  1)

print(paste0("lamda using effect size and SE: ", round(lambda_infl, 3)))
```

```{r}
dir.inflation = file.path(dir.results.DMPS.cCOPD, "/plots/test_inflation")
dir.create(dir.inflation, recursive = TRUE)

all_p_values <- results$P.Value
# Sort p-values in ascending order
sorted_p_values <- sort(all_p_values)
# Calculate expected quantiles under the null hypothesis (uniform distribution)
expected_quantiles <- qunif((1:length(sorted_p_values))/(length(sorted_p_values) + 1))


file.qq <- file.path(dir.inflation, "qq-plot.png")
png(filename = file.qq)

# Plot Q-Q plot
plot(-log10(expected_quantiles),
     -log10(sorted_p_values), 
     xlab = expression("Expected -log10 (p-values)"), 
     ylab = expression("Observed -log10 (p-values)"),
     main = paste0(
       "Q-Q Plot of p-values without lambda correction (lambda = ", round(lambda_infl, 3),")"),
     pch = 20
     )
abline(0, 1, col = "red")  # Add a line for reference

# Add a legend
legend("topleft", legend = "Expected Distribution", col = "red", lty = 1, pch = 20)

dev.off()
```


```{r}
explore_regression_results <- function(DMPs){
  # Explore the data
  print(paste0("Total significant probes: ", dim(DMPs[DMPs$adj.P.Val < 0.05,])[1])) 
  # 0 < LogFC
  print(
    paste0(
      "Significant probes with positive LogFC: ",
      dim(DMPs[DMPs$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & DMPs$logFC > 0,])[1]
      )
    )
  # 0> LogFC
  print(paste0(
    "Significant probes with negative logFC: ",
    dim(DMPs[DMPs$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & DMPs$logFC < 0,])[1]
    )
  ) 
  print(paste0(
    "lamda:  ",
    round(lambda_infl, 3)
   )
  )
}
explore_regression_results(results)
```

### Power analysis paper:
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31088362/

"The recommended significance threshold for DNA methylation association analyses is P < 9.42x10-8 as determined from a permutation analysis."

```{r}
# genome-wide sig cpgs
sig <- ifelse(DMPs$`P.Value` < 9e-8, 1, 0)
table(sig)  # 1 sig
```
